headline: Endurance Technologies Limited: Acquisition
sum: Acquisition - Endurance Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about acquisition of remaining 32% stake in Stoeferle GmbH and Stoeferle Automotive GmbH by Endurance Overseas SpA, Italy, a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Company.
